730e42c7fdf8624a1b29952f7d72cd849288c2d4: Gantrisch-Gurnigel is a low-key resort on a modest scale: 6 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. Gantrisch-Gurnigel's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. The modest altitude of Gantrisch-Gurnigel, with the base at 1340 m and the summit at 1590 m, makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside this window, checking the snow reports before setting off is strongly advised. At 46€, the day lift pass places Gantrisch-Gurnigel among the intermediate resorts on budget: neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and its facilities justifies the price for most skiers. In short, Gantrisch-Gurnigel doesn't rival the giants of skiing, and doesn't claim to. It is an honest destination, often underestimated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
